title: Alarm
prompt: The robot's alarm is three blinks and then the word alarm, all from one call in `run`. The output is blink, blink, blink, alarm.
hints: blink prints "blink"; alarm calls blink three times and then prints "alarm"; run calls alarm once.
alarm has four lines: three `blink()` calls and one print.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
